# Team description, role justification, and capacity

**PI:** PhDr. Hana Georgi, Ph.D. – overall scientific leadership; neuropsychological battery supervision; psychometric strategy; dissemination. Prior work in neuropsychological measurement/review supports readiness.

Senior researcher: Mgr. Filip Havlík, Ph.D. – longitudinal modeling, cognitive efficiency metrics, advanced statistics, and reproducible pipelines; experience in neuropsychological research outputs.

Survey/qualitative mapping lead (optional deepening): Eva Dubovská, Ph.D. – development of survey-based construct mapping (open-ended modules, thematic coding framework), integration with quantitative psychometrics; expertise in narrative/meaning-making research.

Data manager: Martina Maná, MSc. – data structure, QA/QC, codebooks, DMP coordination; documented experience in neuropsychological methods synthesis.

**Data management supervisor:** Mgr. Josef Mana, Ph.D. – oversight of neuropsychological methodology, harmonization, and reproducibility standards; relevant publication track in neuropsychological measurement.

Clinical consultant (HRT and menopause medicine): MUDr. Tomáš Fait, Ph.D. – ensures valid characterization of menopausal status pathways, HRT exposure metadata, and medically coherent interpretation; contributes to knowledge translation while preserving non-interventional design.
